description:
Adática engineering is a Spanish SME that was born as a company specialized in the design of aircraft refueling systems but has gradually turned into a multidisciplinary engineering company. Nowadays, it offers specialized services and products to the industry in five main fields:
+ Engineering Design Office: design of fluid, electrical and mechanical systems, comprising from product definition to stress, testing and certification activities.
+ Additive Manufacturing: design, functional and strength optimization, material and manufacturing technology selection and manufacturing with both in-house capacities (FDM, SLS, SLA) or from its supply chain partners. 
+ Prototyping: design and manufacturing of prototypes of systems and structures, including electronics and software, able to cover the complete cycle from requirements to delivery of the end product ready for testing.
+ Innovation: product development to solve specific problems, pushing the state-of-the-art and generate new added value to the products and services provided by the company. 
+ Digital Transformation and AI: development of products and services that embraces state-of-the-art digital technologies, approaches, tools and practices striving towards a fully data-driven decision-making models and autonomous systems.
Adática engineering is recognized as an Innovative SME by the Spanish Ministry of Science and Innovation. So far, it has participated in three H2020 Clean Sky 2 development projects: ADDAPTTA Seals, HLFC 4.0 and ICEPASS.
It is an EN9100:2018 certified company for the management of engineering projects and services in the field of design and calculation of systems, structures and tools for the aerospace sector.

entityDescription:
MediaTek is a fabless semiconductor company, which is another way of saying we design chips for electronic devices that our partners manufacture.
We design cutting-edge system-on-chip (SoC) solutions for cellular handsets and tablet devices; fixed and wireless connectivity; high-definition TV; optical storage and DVD and Blu-ray products.
MediaTek is headquartered in Taiwan and has sales and research subsidiaries in mainland China, Singapore, India, U.S., Japan, South Korea, Denmark, the UK, Sweden and Dubai. Our R&D centre in Cambourne (near Cambridge) develops smartphone SW and cellular system technology, and our R&D centre in Kent develops RF technology. MTK Wireless Ltd is the UK operation of MediaTek Inc. In the UK, we have two R&D centers – both working on technology for our future SoC wireless chipsets. Our R&D centre in Cambourne (near Cambridge) develops SW and system technology, and our R&D centre in Kent develops RF technology
MediaTek'sWirelessProducts
MediaTek has cumulatively shipped well over 2.5Bn cellular chipsets since entering the cellular market segment less than a decade ago. MediaTek’s “total solution” turnkey approach, and insatiable appetite for excellence in modem solutions, has enabled our customers to successfully deploy MediaTek powered handsets in over 150 countries worldwide. Most recently, our 3G chipsets have been at the forefront of enabling the democratization of smartphones for the mass market. In addition to cellular chipsets, MediaTek has developed leading edge wireless connectivity technology, including Wi-Fi, BT GPS and NFC.
MediaTek in Finland

MediaTek Finland focuses in 5G/6G modem chipset development, containing embedded system SW development, algorithm and HW design as well as modem integration and verification. MediaTek Finland has close co-operation with European network vendors and mobile network operators and participates also to 3GPP specification work.

Clue Aerospace SL, is a Spanish SME, stands as a pivotal entity in the aerospace industry, specializing in the manufacturing, commercialization, and support of cutting-edge embedded electronic systems designed for critical applications. This subsidiary of the Clue group focuses on manufacturing sophisticated solutions tailored to the demanding needs of the aerospace sector.
The manufacturing process at Clue Aerospace is comprehensive and intricate, encompassing various stages such as Surface-Mount Technology (SMT), Backend processing, production of Mechanical parts, and rigorous Testing procedures. This extensive range of processes ensures that each component and system meets the highest standards of quality and reliability, essential for aerospace applications.
In line with the dynamic nature of the aerospace industry, Clue Aerospace employs Agile Manufacturing and Rapid Prototyping techniques. These methodologies allow for quick iteration of design prototypes, providing the flexibility to adapt swiftly to emerging technologies and evolving customer requirements. This approach enables Clue Aerospace to stay at the forefront of innovation, continually refining and enhancing its product offerings to meet the critical demands of the aerospace industry effectively.
By integrating agile practices into its manufacturing processes, Clue Aerospace ensures not only the production of high-quality systems but also the ability to respond promptly to the fast-paced changes and advancements characteristic of the aerospace sector. This agility, combined with a deep commitment to supporting and commercializing its electronic systems, positions Clue Aerospace as a key player in the development of advanced technologies for the aerospace industry.

description: Arceon develops ceramic matrix composite materials and structures.
entityDescription: Arceon B.V. is an engineering company located in the Netherlands, focussed on the research, development and application of ceramic matrix composite materials. The company consists of a strong team of engineers, and an in-house manufacturing capability. Ceramic matrix composite materials (CMCs) are a combination of ceramics and composites, utilizing the advantages of both. Like polymer composites, they use reinforcing fibres like carbon or silicon carbide to provide strength and stiffness. The matrix consists of a ceramic, usually silicon carbide, which provides high temperature performance and ablative resistance. Arceon uses carbon fibres in a silicon carbide matrix, which results in attractive material properties: low density (1.9-2.1 g/cm3 ), high temperature resistance (stable up to at least 1600 °C), low CTE (-1 – 2.5 10-6 K -1 ) and high strength (flexural strength up to 300 MPa). Also, by using different fibres and additives, many of the properties can be tailored to specific applications.

entityDescription: Foresting Tomorrow ApS was established in 2019 with the purpose of developing a new digital tool (Skovkortet.dk) for forest owners and managers. The tool can be used to optimize and manage the operation of planted areas and to document the occurrences and activities of forest areas with regard to areas, species, age, quantities, diameters, harvesting times, key biotopes, cultural values, and more. The idea for the tool and the current solution were developed by Jens Isbak and Rasmus Pedersen, and later Henrik Neergaard-Petersen joined as a partner. Since its launch in 2019, the development has been rapid, and today, 30% of the Danish forest area is registered in Skovkortet, corresponding to over 3,000 forests. Additionally, there are close customer relationships with companies like HedeDanmark, Danish Forestry Association, a number of municipalities and private forest owners In 2023, our current solution was updated to an international version called, Forsler.com, which enables global scaling and simplifies future product expansions. Our central vision is to promote the transition to a more sustainable future by offering a high-quality digital forest platform that provides forest owners, managers, and organizations with the necessary tools to manage their forests in an environmentally responsible and sustainable manner.

entityDescription: AALTO, a subsidiary of Airbus, is a global leader in connectivity and earth observation services from the stratosphere. Based in Farnborough, UK, the Company designs, manufactures and offers services using its record-breaking Zephyr High Altitude Platform Station (HAPS). Powered by solar energy and operating above 60,000+ feet, Zephyr’s persistence enables continuous flight for months at a time. Its current flight-time record is over 64 days in the stratosphere. As a payload agnostic platform, Zephyr can deliver several applications, including low-latency 5G direct-to-device (D2D) connectivity and high-quality earth observation services. Those solutions will deliver for several markets including mobile greenfield connectivity, disaster management, border protection, and precision agriculture.
